provenance.paper_title: DynaMem: Online Dynamic Spatio-Semantic Memory for Open World Mobile Manipulation

evidence.paraphrase: Each voxel retains 3D location, an observation count, a count-weighted semantic feature, latest time, and latest contributing image identifier.
Text-to-feature similarity selects a voxel and its latest associated image for object verification.
The latest image identifier stored with a selected voxel resolves back to an RGB observation used by the multimodal verifier.

A fixed voxel-assignment rule adds new points and updates feature, count, time, and source-image metadata. For DynaMem, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of dynamic spatio-semantic voxel point cloud.

Ray casting removes voxels that should be visible in the current camera frustum but are absent from the new depth observation. For DynaMem, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of dynamic spatio-semantic voxel point cloud.

derived.hybrid_relation: The image link preserves provenance within the same source/native parent family.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (dynamic spatio-semantic voxel point cloud) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
